topic.angle: A naval blockade, a deal and a hotline

panels.text: In 1961 the US placed nuclear Jupiter missiles in Italy and Turkey, all within range of Moscow.
In October 1962 the world learned that Soviet nuclear missiles were in Cuba. On 22 October, President Kennedy ordered a naval blockade.
He called it a 'quarantine', not a blockade, so the US could avoid the formal implications of a state of war.

The crisis ended on 28 October with a deal. The Soviets removed their missiles, the US promised not to invade Cuba, and US missiles left Turkey and Italy without publicity. A Moscow-Washington hotline followed.

probes.question: Why did Kennedy call the blockade a 'quarantine'?
options: To avoid the formal implications of a state of war
Because it was only for ships carrying food

probes.question: True or false: the deal included the secret removal of American missiles from Turkey and Italy.

claims.claim: In 1961 the US put Jupiter missiles in Italy and Turkey, all within range of Moscow
claims.quote: In 1961 the US put Jupiter nuclear missiles in Italy and Turkey . All were within range of Moscow

claims.claim: In October 1962 the world learned of Soviet missiles in Cuba
claims.quote: Kennedy delivered a nationwide televised address on all of the major networks announcing the discovery of the missiles

claims.claim: 22 October Kennedy ordered a naval blockade
claims.quote: On 22 October, Kennedy ordered a naval blockade to prevent further missiles from reaching Cuba

claims.claim: He called it a quarantine so the US could avoid the formal implications of a state of war (p1)
claims.quote: He referred to the blockade as a "quarantine", not as a blockade, so the US could avoid the formal implications of a state of war
The crisis lasted from 16 to 28 October 1962

claims.claim: Soviets dismantled missiles, US agreed not to invade Cuba
claims.quote: in exchange for a US public declaration and agreement not to invade Cuba again

claims.claim: US secretly removed missiles from Turkey (p2)
claims.quote: The United States secretly agreed to dismantle all of the offensive weapons it had deployed to Turkey

claims.claim: US missiles left Turkey and Italy without publicity (p2)
claims.quote: the withdrawal of US missiles from Italy and Turkey was a secret deal between Kennedy and Khrushchev
The evident necessity of a quick and direct communication line between the two powers resulted in the Moscow-Washington hotline
